prompt: A general motors vehicle is named after the largest ward in the country of Monaco.  How many people had walked on the moon as of the first model year of the vehicle? Note: the model year is not the same as the year the model was first produced.
answer:
The vehicle is the **Chevrolet Monte Carlo**, named for Monaco’s Monte Carlo ward. Although production began in **1969**, its first **model year was 1970**.

By then, **four people** had walked on the Moon:

- Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin (Apollo 11, 1969)
- Pete Conrad and Alan Bean (Apollo 12, 1969)
